In [[Four-dimensional space|four-dimensional]] [[Euclidean geometry]], the '''steric tesseractic honeycomb''' is a uniform space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]) in Euclidean 4-space.

== Alternate names==
* Small diprismatodemitesseractic tetracomb (siphatit)
